item.title: Day 2: the crossing
item.description: For the first time, the wolf buried more than it burned: 805,481 bought back against 393,446 gone to smoke. The launch fires are ash. What feeds the lock now is the bank, worked out a slice at a time.

item.description: The 2% muzzle comes off — by the launch schedule. Uncapped from here on. The schedule says forever; forever is untested.

item.title: Day 0: FEEDING №1 · 10/10 dens
item.description: 43,961,113 PACK burned · 658,308 bought back and buried deeper The first meal. The launch bots pushed 811,000,000 PACK through the NVDA den in six hours, paying 1% each pass. Every fee ended in the wolf's teeth. 4.4% of everything, gone in two minutes. The wolf did not thank them. Keepers fed: 0x346dc337, 0xd2546e1d — 444,052 in bounties (PACK side). ── milestone: 1%. Then 2%. Then 3%. Then 4% of genesis, smoke. All in one meal. ──

item.title: Day 0: the first muzzle
item.description: The 0.5% muzzle comes off — by the launch schedule, not witnessed. The lock records what it is told here.

item.title: Day 0: genesis
item.description: Born in one transaction. 1,000,000,000 minted. Ten dens dug — six smell of equities, four smell of memes. Ten full-range positions sealed into a lock with no doors. 50,000,000 poured into a bowl the creator cannot touch for 30 days. There was no second transaction.
